summary: fix(settings): spell the pairing cancellation heading "Cancelled"
description:
## Because

- The pairing flow spelled the cancellation heading as "Canceled" on one device and "Cancelled" on the other.
- The reporter chose the British spelling "Cancelled" for the mobile screen.

## This pull request

- Changes the Pair2 Authority and Supplicant cancellation heading to "Cancelled".
- Updates both `en.ftl` files and the English fallback strings in the two `index.tsx` files.
- Updates the four test strings that assert the heading.
- Keeps the `-canceled-` FTL ids as they are. A rename of an id drops every translation of that string.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FXA-14503
